source_note: 0.3.0 Base/Egress/Runtime contract source (Issue #166). stage-contracts.mjs, json-contract.mjs and operation-stacks.mjs are exact byte copies from that commit. deployment-contract.mjs is the raw producer file with exactly one declared import rewrite, recorded in import_rewrites: the bare package specifier is replaced with the vendored package entry because this repository consumes the dependency-free package source instead of installing a tarball. The loader reverses the declared rewrite, asserts the raw producer hash from producer_files and refuses any other difference. The Service release slice is the Runtime stack: SERVICE_RUNTIME_STACK (AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta, ap-east-1), runtimeStackName and runtimeStageFromStack replace the former Workload identity, and the stage contract adds the unconditional api_base_url parameter (36 definitions, 35 unconditional, 1 conditional). AnyWearEgressStack-beta is operation-owned and is never part of the configured three-stack Infra manifest, so the recorded tuple stays three Infra stacks plus one Service stack.

package.name: @git-malu/stage-contracts
package.note: Packed 0.3.0 tarball pin for consumers that install @git-malu/stage-contracts, packed from Infra commit 29601d9a2264e69544daccbe7d4b7f29fe2a5991; the tarball's index.mjs is exactly the vendored stage-contracts.mjs bytes. Version 0.3.0 renames the Service release slice to the Runtime stack (runtimeStackName, SERVICE_RUNTIME_STACK, runtimeStageFromStack) and exports validateServiceStacks; no AnyWearWorkloadStack, SERVICE_WORKLOAD_STACK or workloadStageFromStack export remains. It adds the unconditional api_base_url stage-contract parameter (36 definitions, 35 unconditional, 1 conditional) that Base publishes and the Service release chain reads. This repository adds no dependency and does not commit the tarball; it consumes the same package entry in install-free form. No stage-contracts-v0.3.0 tag exists: the tag is created only after the Infra merge at Deployment, so this pin does not claim one.
